petard.s: a fat firecracker fizzing alone on empty night cobblestones, every balcony shutter above flung open at once, one cat launching skyward

pupa.s: a towering grinning papier-mache carnival head on a wheeled float, paint still wet, one enormous ear already sagging off

kavallier.s: a proud man in a faded threadbare festa shirt, wavy stink lines rising off him, two flies circling his collar, beaming

nar.s: a colossal golden firework burst over a dark church dome, and one small charred stick tumbling back down through the smoke

statwa.s: a huge gilded pedestal statue borne on a wooden platform, eight pairs of straining legs below it, one grimacing face peeking out

kunjata.s: a monumental grandmother in black, arms folded, one eyebrow arched, dragging a white-gloved fingertip along a shelf and finding dust

gbejna.s: one tiny pepper-crusted cheeselet alone in the middle of a big plate, flanked by three enormous drained tumblers

bidwi.s: a weather-beaten farmer gripping a tractor steering wheel, jaw clenched, eyes locked forward, a small dented car roof visible ahead of him

harrub.s: a vast gnarled carob tree on dry ground, its trunk slowly swallowing a rusted plough and an old wooden chair

nanna.s: a tiny grandmother tipping an enormous pot of baked pasta onto an already overflowing plate, a thin young man leaning away alarmed

traffiku.s: bumper-to-bumper cars halted under a concrete flyover, one driver reclined fast asleep, a pigeon nesting comfortably on his wing mirror

krejn.s: a towering crane lowering a grey concrete slab onto a tiny ornate limestone townhouse squeezed between two blank walls

wejter.s: a waiter with eight plates stacked up one arm, apron crisp, fixed unmeant smile, one eyelid twitching, bead of sweat

burokrat.s: a clerk's hand sliding a thick stack of blank forms back out through a counter hatch, a wilting applicant's shoulders sagging

kera.s: a tiny balcony flat perched atop a swaying tower of gold coins, one tenant clinging to the railing, key dangling

ministru.s: a beaming pompous suited man with both palms spread wide in promise, fingers firmly crossed behind his back, gold cufflinks

kuntrattur.s: a half-plastered room, a cement mixer set solid with cobwebs strung across it, a shrugging workman in a hard hat holding coffee

luzzu.s: the painted prow of a wooden fishing boat, its big painted eye swivelled sideways to stare straight at the viewer

sajjied.s: a grinning fisherman holding both hands absurdly far apart, and in the bucket at his elbow one very small sardine

turist.s: a lobster-red tourist wincing as he pokes his own shoulder, pale sunglasses shape around his eyes, unopened sun cream in hand

bram.s: a huge translucent purple jellyfish rising through clear water beneath one pair of small kicking feet, more drifting up behind

gar.s: a wrinkled face pressed to a cracked-open green shutter, one hand parting the slats, both eyes wide and delighted

exwife.s: a living room sawn precisely in half down the middle, one confused small dog sitting exactly on the dividing line

karozzin.s: a plumed carriage horse trotting off briskly, the empty ornate carriage bouncing behind, reins trailing, a driver's cap still spinning midair

boss.s: a defeated man in a dressing gown and one slipper, phone clamped to his ear, coffee gone cold, shadows stretched long

group.s: a phone buzzing so hard it walks off a table edge, a spray of identical little flower photos physically spilling out

kafe.s: a tiny espresso cup radiating shock rings, the black surface trembling, hairline cracks spreading across the saucer beneath it

ambulanza.s: a white ambulance rolling up at last with its light bar blazing, a cobweb strung between its wing mirror and door

meta.s: a single raised hand, fingertips pinched tightly together, jabbing the air with bold motion arcs, shirt cuff flapping loose

festalights.s: a towering gilded arch strung with hundreds of glowing bulbs blazing above a narrow street, one dazed moth spiralling around it

blackout.s: an old wall switch box hanging open with sparks fizzling out of it, one lit candle balanced on top

kbarat.s: two hands locked in a discreet handshake, a small brass key half-hidden between the palms, smart cuffs and a gold watch

bieb.s: a car door flung wide into the next car's paintwork, a fresh scrape and a fallen wing mirror, nobody anywhere

mara.s: a woman filling a doorway with her arms folded, and a man frozen mid-tiptoe before her, shoes held in one hand

abbati.s: a wild-eyed boy in a red and white robe whirling a steaming brass censer overhead, incense spiralling, empty can at his feet

bomba.s: a man on a flat roof staring up delighted at three small grey smoke puffs in an empty bright sky, ears covered

banda2.s: two facing balconies across a narrow gap, a uniformed bandsman on each, both turned pointedly away, arms folded, chins high

partitarju.s: a burly man weeping with joy, hands clasped to his chest, sash across his shirt, confetti stuck in his damp hair

purcissjoni.s: a line of candle-carrying robed figures seen from behind shuffling forward, and a snail on the kerb overtaking them easily

marc.s: three bandsmen marching under a night sky, jackets off, ties loose, cheeks puffed purple, a bass drum punched right through

katarina.s: a squat stone shed in a dry field, its door tied shut with frayed string, roof blackened, one thin curl of smoke

bebbux.s: a galvanised bucket brimming with garden snails, a dozen of them already escaping over the rim and sliming down the side

tigiega.s: a furious hen glaring straight ahead, wings half-raised, feathers bristling, one sprig of rosemary tucked jauntily behind its comb

hanzir.s: a vast contented pig resting its chin on a rubble wall, wavy green stink lines rising, laundry on a line wilting

ghalqa.s: a dry-stone rubble wall standing perfectly straight while the modern concrete wall beside it has slumped into a heap

ghannej.s: a lean old man mid-wail, mouth wide, eyes squeezed shut, one finger jabbing accusingly at the viewer, guitar neck across his chest

ghasfur.s: a camouflaged man hidden in a leafy blind, only binoculars and two eyes showing, a small finch perched cheekily on the lenses

raddiena.s: a stone windmill with half its sails missing still turning steadily, the rusted scaffolding around it sagging and half fallen

tigrija.s: two trotting sulkies racing neck and neck through a dust cloud, a torn blank paper slip fluttering away behind them

zija.s: a beaming aunt in an apron blocking a doorway with one arm, hoisting a steaming pot with the other, second plate ready

parkegg.s: a battered sun-bleached plastic chair sitting alone in an empty parking bay, weeds through its legs, one cat guarding it

bus.s: a bus roaring past a kerbside stop in a cloud of exhaust, one lone figure left behind with an arm still raised

skavaturi.s: a drill bit bursting down through a bedroom ceiling, plaster dust raining onto a bed, one pillow clamped hard over a head

bouncer.s: a slab-shouldered bouncer in dark glasses filling a doorway, arms folded, one flat palm raised, velvet rope clipped shut beside him

kunsill.s: a small official leaning from an ornate balcony pointing accusingly downward, directly beneath him a broken street lamp dangling untouched

penthouse.s: a glossy rooftop penthouse whose wide glass balcony faces a blank concrete wall an arm's length away, one dusty deckchair waiting

notar.s: a dry bespectacled notary droning aloud from a blank scroll unfurling past his knees, one finger tracking down the empty page

permess.s: a rubber stamp slamming onto a blank sheet in a dark deserted office, one desk lamp lit, an empty chair still spinning
